body.summary: Before changing anything, confirm that createReviewPresenter and its PresentedTurn handle, the exported presentedPathOf, the tool-call TurnEvent in stream-events.ts, and the Claude and Codex mappers in cli-adapter.ts have the shapes the LLD assumes (toolResult and end on the handle; no input on the tool-call event; Codex handling only command_execution and tool_call on item.completed). Record the symbols and shapes found as the task's reported evidence (no test is added); stop and report if any differs.
acceptanceChecks: Each of the existing symbols the LLD changes or removes was read in the code and its shape is recorded against the LLD's before state
Any difference from the LLD is reported, not worked around
